{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Count QA orders
num_qa = qa_orders.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99): {num_qa}")

# Filter out QA orders
real_orders = df[~qa_orders]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after filtering QA and cleaning): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
